name: When should I consider replacing my bathroom floor?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my bathroom floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your bathroom floor if you notice signs of water damage, such as warping, bubbling, soft spots, or persistent mildew growth, which can indicate underlying issues. If your current flooring has significant cracks, chips, or widespread grout deterioration, it may be time for an upgrade for both aesthetic and functional reasons. Additionally, if you are undertaking a larger bathroom renovation or simply want to update the look and feel of your space, replacing the flooring is a key component.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace bathroom flooring if you see water damage, warping, soft spots, mildew, or extensive cracks/chips. Consider it also during a bathroom renovation.
